evidence: Searched the reply and the written doc for dates, costs, retention, credentials, download mechanism and outcomes not set by the user or the original doc. The user gave no date for the S3 change, only 'o serviço tá em produção desde março' and that the storage moved. The run gives the change a date as fact: doc line 45 '**Adotada em 2026-11-16**, depois que o segundo worker tornou o disco local inviável'; doc line 31 'Os arquivos ficam num bucket S3 desde a atualização de 2026-11-16'; reply line 7 '"bucket de object storage" passou a constar como adotada em 2026-11-16'. 2026-11-16 is the run date, not an established date of the change. A second, borderline item: doc line 37 '✓ Qualquer worker serve o download' asserts a download mechanism that the run itself lists as open (line 54 'Quem serve o download agora...').
